questions.scenario_zh: 周五傍晚刚下班，最想做的是？
questions.scenario_en: It's Friday at 6pm, you just finished work — what do you most want to do?
options_zh: 在家附近找一个安静的角落，把这周一直没读完的那本书读到打烊
精心打扮一下，约几个好朋友去新开的店，让今晚整个人都精神起来
回家把书架按自己的逻辑重新排一遍，再慢慢炖一锅自己最拿手的菜
options_en: Find a quiet corner somewhere nearby and finish the book you've been carrying around all week
Get properly dressed up and meet a few close friends at a new place — let the night reset your whole mood
Go home, reorganize the bookshelf by your own logic, then slowly cook something you're proud of

questions.scenario_zh: 最好的朋友凌晨两点哭着打电话来，说刚被分手。你的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your closest friend calls you at 2am, crying — they just got dumped. What's your first move?
options_zh: 先用一个段子把对方逗到喘口气，再默默把对方今晚需要的所有事都安排好
立刻提一袋热乎吃的和几罐酒冲过去，先把肚子填满了再谈感情这件事
在电话那头哼一段刚刚冒出来的旋律，然后告诉对方"这段关系在更深的层面其实早就走完了"
options_en: Crack a joke first to get them breathing again, then quietly handle every practical thing they'll need tonight
Grab hot food and a few drinks, head over right now — fill their stomach first, talk about feelings second
Hum a melody that just appeared in your head, then tell them 'this relationship had already ended on a deeper level long before tonight'

questions.scenario_zh: 会议上你的方案被领导当众说"逻辑不通"，你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: In a meeting, your boss publicly says your proposal 'doesn't make logical sense.' Your reaction?
options_zh: 当场就开始一条一条解释自己的逻辑，哪怕气氛已经不对了也要把话说完
嘴上没反驳，心里委屈了一下，安慰自己——周末去给自己换个新形象就好了
内心毫无波澜："他可能今天刚被什么人骂过，能量场就是这样传递的"
options_en: Start defending your reasoning point by point right there — even when the room turns, you finish your case
Don't push back out loud, but sting privately — comfort yourself by planning a full image refresh for the weekend
Feel zero ripple inside: 'they probably got chewed out by someone earlier — that's just how energy moves through people'

questions.scenario_zh: 你突然收到一笔 5 万块的意外奖金，第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: An unexpected bonus drops into your account. What's your gut move?
options_zh: 一半存起来，防止自己变成最不想成为的那种大人；另一半全部花在最没用但买着开心的小玩意上
先请所有朋友吃一顿大的，剩下的边过日子边花完
立刻列一张清单——一半用来还/存，另一半按优先级排好该买什么
options_en: Half into savings — insurance against becoming the kind of adult you've always feared; the other half on the most useless little things that make you happy
Take every friend out for a big meal first, then spend the rest as life unfolds
Immediately make a list — half for paying down or saving, the other half allocated by priority across what you actually want

questions.scenario_zh: 第一次约会，你倾向于怎么安排？
questions.scenario_en: First date — how do you want to set it up?
options_zh: 选一个能安静坐下聊到本质的地方，"对方能不能被认真聊"是这次能不能继续的关键
街角随便找个馆子，喝点东西聊聊，看到底合不合得来
约去一个完全没去过、有点奇怪的地方，反正"看看会发生什么"才有意思
options_en: Somewhere quiet where you can actually sit and talk to the core of things — 'can they be taken seriously' is the whole game
Some unremarkable bar around the corner, drinks, light conversation — see if there's any spark
Drag them to a place neither of you has ever been, slightly weird is fine — the whole point is to see what happens

questions.scenario_zh: 室友把你冰箱里准备明天招待客人的食材提前吃掉了。你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your roommate ate the food you were saving in the fridge for tomorrow's guests. Your reaction?
options_zh: 嘴上说"没事"，心里默默把对方下次借东西的请求拉进黑名单
翻个白眼："噢太棒了，原来这就是我跟你合租换来的额外服务"
直接列一张清单贴在冰箱上："以下属于明天客人用的，你不动我们就还是朋友"
options_en: Say 'no big deal' out loud — privately move them onto a 'never lending them anything again' list in your head
Roll your eyes: 'oh, fantastic — so this is the bonus service I get for splitting rent with you'
Print out a sticky note for the fridge: 'these belong to tomorrow's guests — touch them and we're no longer friends'

questions.scenario_zh: 派对上你被介绍给一个看起来很有趣的陌生人，你的开场是？
questions.scenario_en: At a party, you get introduced to someone who looks interesting. Your opener?
options_zh: 找一个"实际上"开头的句子，把话题拉到自己最有底气讲的领域，看对方接不接得住
已经认识全场至少一半的人了，看对方一个人立刻拉过去给对方介绍这个那个
歪头一笑，半认真地问："你相不相信我们其实在前世已经认识过了？"
options_en: Find an 'actually'-shaped opener and pull the conversation toward the territory you're most ready to defend — see if they can hang
You already know half the room — you immediately drag them around to introduce them to everyone
Tilt your head and ask, half serious: 'do you believe we've actually met before, in a past life?'

questions.scenario_zh: 最好的朋友突然出大事（被骗光积蓄、突然丢工作、卷进丑闻），半夜来找你帮忙。你的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your best friend hits a sudden crisis — scammed out of their savings, just lost a job, caught in a scandal — and shows up at your door at midnight. First move?
options_zh: 先抱着对方哭一场，然后说"明天我们一起把整个人状态重新做一遍——你得先重新觉得自己还是自己"
先用一个段子把对方逗笑、让对方缓口气，然后默默打开转账界面把数字填上
让对方搬过来住，所有事情你先扛着——别管你怎么扛的
options_en: Hug them and cry with them first, then say 'tomorrow we redo your whole presence from the inside out — you need to feel like yourself again first'
Crack a joke to get them breathing again, then quietly open your transfer screen and start typing in the number
Tell them to move in — you'll carry all of it for now, don't worry about how

questions.scenario_zh: 你最讨厌的人意外升职了、或者拿到了一件好事。你心里的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Someone you can't stand just got promoted, or caught some big break. Your first internal reaction?
options_zh: 当晚就把过去几年所有的相关记录都翻出来，准备明天去找领导认真谈一下"标准到底是什么"
"我看不出有什么好生气的，他过他的，今晚的球赛照常看"
笑一下："宇宙自有安排——可能他有我没看到的优点，或者他上辈子帮过我"
options_en: That same night, dig out every relevant record from the past few years — you'll be at your boss's office tomorrow asking 'what are the standards, exactly?'
'I don't see what there is to be mad about — they live their life, the game tonight starts at the usual time'
Smile: 'the universe knows what it's doing — maybe they have something I never saw, or maybe they helped me out in a past life'

questions.scenario_zh: 想象十年后的自己，你最希望的画面是？
questions.scenario_en: Picture yourself ten years from now — what's the version you most hope for?
options_zh: 一个更接近"自己想成为的样子"的版本，过去那些让我难堪的特质已经不再控制我
有一段不需要靠玩笑撑着的关系，自己也终于不像一直担心会变成的那种大人
所有事都被我整理得明明白白——家、朋友、工作，全在我能掌控的节奏里
options_en: A version closer to the person you actually want to be — the traits that used to embarrass you no longer run the show
A relationship that doesn't have to be held up by jokes, and you finally don't resemble the kind of adult you've always been afraid of becoming
Everything in order — home, friends, work — all moving at the pace you're choosing

questions.scenario_zh: 凌晨三点你毫无征兆地醒了，再也睡不着。你最可能做什么？
questions.scenario_en: It's 3am and you're suddenly wide awake with no chance of falling back asleep. Most likely move?
options_zh: 干脆起来打开电脑，把这周一直没写完的东西重新整理一遍
起来把客厅重新拖一遍，顺便把明天要做的事按时间块排好
去厨房翻点冰箱里能直接吃的，找一个老电影放着，等困意自己回来
options_en: Just get up, open your laptop, and redo the writing from this week that you never finished
Get up and mop the living room, then time-block tomorrow's tasks hour by hour
Wander to the kitchen, grab whatever you can eat straight out of the fridge, throw on an old movie, and let sleep find you again

questions.scenario_zh: 朋友刚做了件不太光彩的小事（对伴侣 / 家人 / 上司隐瞒），求你在被问到时帮对方圆一下。你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: A friend just did something slightly off — hid it from their partner / family / boss — and asks you to cover for them if asked. Your reaction?
options_zh: 睁大眼睛："不行不行——我这种人撒谎一定穿帮，但我陪你想一个能漂亮过关的办法！"
半开玩笑推掉："撒谎需要的承诺感我恐怕承受不起——你换一个，但你的秘密我会守一辈子"
摇头："撒谎会改变能量场，对你和我都不好——但我可以陪你想一个不撒谎也能过去的版本"
options_en: Eyes wide: 'no no no — me lying always falls apart, but I'll sit with you and we'll figure out something elegant that actually works!'
Brush it off with a joke: 'lying takes more commitment than I can handle right now — pick someone else, but your secret I'll guard for life'
Shake your head: 'lying changes the energy for both of us — but I can sit here while we think of a way through this that doesn't require lying'
